name: Browserless
description: Runs hosted or self-hosted headless browsers for agents and scripts, with REST APIs for screenshots, PDFs, and scraping, Puppeteer/Playwright over WebSocket, and an MCP server.

skills.name: Browser REST APIs
skills.description: Returns screenshots, PDFs, rendered HTML, or structured scrape results from one-shot HTTP calls to /screenshot, /pdf, /content, and /scrape.

skills.name: Browsers As A Service
skills.description: Connects existing Puppeteer, Playwright, or other CDP scripts to managed Chromium sessions over WebSocket, with stealth and proxy options.

skills.name: BrowserQL Automation
skills.description: Runs GraphQL-style BrowserQL queries against stealth browser sessions to navigate, extract data, and solve CAPTCHAs on bot-protected sites.

skills.name: MCP Browser Agent
skills.description: Gives AI assistants a stateful browser agent plus smart scraping, page export, crawling, and Lighthouse audits through the Browserless MCP server.
